label: A necessary concrete varying giver, from Pruss's grounding and P2-delta (inference)
rule: Weaken P2-delta to P2-prime, apply the route with Pruss's premise, then apply P2-delta to its holder
meaning: P2-delta gives P2-prime (forget the difference in giving), so the route with Pruss's own premise (42da6b2d, theorem prussActualAbsenceNecessaryPowerHolder, reused) gives a concrete holder y existing at w and at every accessible world, with a power for the joint absence; P2-delta applied to y gives an accessible world where y exists and gives being otherwise than at w.
